data.long_meaning: Hasmat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'has' meaning 'smile' or 'joy' and 'mat' meaning 'that which is stable'. This name is believed to bring happiness and joy to the bearer. It is a name for a boy who is expected to bring delight and joy to those around him. The name Hasmat carries the meaning “Smile, Joy, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hasmat usually hope their child will grow to embody smile, joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
